diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

`:resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster` explicitly depends on `:resource.aws_eks_cluster.this`, but its provisioner environment reads the cluster endpoint, which already creates an implicit dependency on that cluster.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group can begin launching nodes before the `aws-auth` ConfigMap is installed. The module explicitly gates managed node groups on this ConfigMap to avoid node registration races; this ASG needs the same ordering.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the worker-node IAM policy is attached, so instances may start without the permissions needed to join and operate in the cluster. Gate the ASG on this attachment, as the module does for managed node groups.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the EKS CNI policy is attached, creating a race where nodes start without the required CNI permissions. Gate the ASG on this attachment, as the module does for managed node groups.

The self-managed worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the ECR read-only policy is attached, creating a race where nodes lack permissions needed to pull container images. Gate the ASG on this attachment, as the module does for managed node groups.
